Changes: isolated one-shots, mono conversion, noise-tail gating, bass transients,
EQ/soft saturation and short reflections. Used for revolver, shotgun and heavy MG.

Hell Forged: original 160 BPM instrumental metal composition for The Last Gate.
Generated from the project script compose-metal.py; no Doom audio is used.
